title: How Many Fit?
premise: Dividing by a decimal asks how many of that small piece fit. Lots of small pieces can fit in a short length.
idea: Dividing decimals: 7.2 ÷ 0.8 = 9, shown as copies of 0.8 laid along 7.2. Ignoring the decimal in the divisor (0.9) is the known slip.
author: claude-stand-in
